channel.description: Daily DP Show episodes without C&R or Best Of clips.

item.title: Hour 3 – Super Bowl Not Stats, PCA Running Away
item.description:
Dan reminds us that Aaron Donald isn’t coming back to rack up career stats, he’s there to win another ring, period. Plus, Cubs CF Pete Crow-Armstrong is starting to pull away in the NL MVP race.

item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 2 – USC Wins but Fans Are Scarce, Joel Klatt
item.description:
Dan and the Danettes discuss the relatively empty stadium that greeted the USC Trojans football team in their opening game of the season. And college football insider Joel Klatt drops by and reacts to the opening salvo from college football over the weekend.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 1 – Aaron Donald Returns to LA, Belichick Wins Opener, Chris Simms
item.description:
Dan was not surprised to hear Aaron Donald is officially returning to the Rams and he talks about how they can best make use of their aging future Hall of Fame pass rusher. He debates how relevant North Carolina’s win over TCU is for Bill Belichick. And he talks to former NFL QB Chris Simms about all things pigskin related.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 3 – Dolphins Waiver Work, Luke Kuechly
item.description:
Dan is a fan of how the Dolphins are using the waiver wire to build their roster. And newly inducted Pro Football Hall of Fame LB Luke Kuechly stops by to chop it up with DP.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 2 – Kyle Whittingham, Kyle Long
item.description:
Dan talks to Michigan HC Kyle Whittingham about their rivalry with Ohio State and the prospect of allowing players to return to college sports after playing in NFL preseason games. Plus, former DE Kyle Long drops by to weigh in on the latest CTE findings.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 1 – Too Hot for USC Fans, Positive NFL Fans
item.description:
Dan and the Danettes think USC looks pretty bad trying to defend the lack of fans at their home opener over the weekend. Plus, they discuss the most positive fanbases in the NFL.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 3 – Undrafted Success, Robert Griffin III
item.description:
Dan and the Danettes discuss some of the best NFL players who came into the league undrafted. And former NFL QB Robert Griffin III stops by to preview Week 1 of the NFL season.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 2 – Dynamic Duos, Ryan Leaf
item.description:
DP and the Danettes talk about some of the most dynamic duos in NFL history as they prepare to watch Myles Garrett and Aaron Donald play together for the Rams. And former NFL QB Ryan Leaf drops by, and they dive deep on Tony Romo and his experience with opioids during and after his own NFL career.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 1 – Fresh Start for the Angels, Tony Romo Comes Clean
item.description:
Dan is confident the Los Angeles Angels will see some improvement now that they are being sold to Stan Kroenke. And DP weighs in on Tony Romo’s statement attempting to take responsibility for his OWI arrest and discusses the perils of opioid use.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 3 – Pablo Torre, Brian Windhorst
item.description:
Investigative reporter Pablo Torre of “Pablo Torre Finds Out” joins Dan to talk about the punishment handed down to the Clippers stemming from his detective work. Torre defends himself and his reporting and explains how the NBA found this evidence. NBA insider Brian Windhorst talks to Dan about the implications for the Clippers from this investigation, the corruption that went into the Clippers arena and the implications for Kawhi Leonard, Steve Ballmer and the rest of the NBA.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 2 – Justin Tucker Tries Again, Tony Petitti
item.description:
Dan weighs in as kicker Justin Tucker gets another tryout and controversy follows him; but does his performance outweigh all of that for his legacy? Big Ten commissioner Tony Petetti joins Dan and talks about the growth of the conference and how they navigate the contemporary age of college football, and the possibility of a big SEC-Big Ten challenge as the two conferences continue to stand above everyone else.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 1 – NBA Drops the Hammer on the Clippers, Mike Tomlin
item.description:
Dan reacts to the punishment handed down by the NBA to Steve Ballmer and the Los Angeles Clippers as they lose picks, money and receive suspension for circumventing the salary cap to pay Kawhi Leonard. And former Steelers HC and now broadcaster Mike Tomlin joins Dan to discuss the transition from coaching to the booth, how he views the impact of Aaron Donald on the football field and what advice he would give to Seahawks coach Mike McDonald as he prepares to defend the Super Bowl title.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 3 – WNBA Commissioner Heading Out, Ross Tucker
item.description:
Dan reacts to news as the embattled WNBA Commissioner Cathy Engelbert is set to depart at the end of the year. Dan speaks as a champion for the WNBA and feels like he just wanted to talk to her when she blew off the show. NFL analyst Ross Tucker joins Dan to talk about the looming NFL season – can the Rams go undefeated? What are the issues facing Buffalo? Can Drake Maye take the next step in New England?

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 2 – College Football Week 1 Preview, Pat Welter
item.description:
Dan and the Danettes react to Thursday’s slate of college football games, and how a new dynamic field of college teams has implications for point spreads. Raleigh WRAL’s Pat Welter joins Dan to discuss the fallout from the investigation around former UNC general manager Mike Lombardi, his improprieties at the university, and what it has all meant for HC Bill Belichick and the Tar Heels football program.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 1 – SEC Vs. LSU, Dan Orlovsky
item.description:
Week 1 of the college football season is underway, and all eyes are on Clemson vs. LSU in the season’s first powerhouse matchup. Football analyst Dan Orlovsky defends his belief that Matthew Stafford is a top 5 quarterback of all time and breaks down some storylines and interesting NFL teams as the season looms large.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 1 - Rob Parker & Kerry Rhodes - Michigan's Hail Mary Should be the END of Instant Replay
item.description:
Rob Parker & Kerry Rhodes are in for Dan and the Danette's on a Labor Day edition of The Dan Patrick Show. The guys are furious about Michigan's Hail Mary, to which Rob says it's time to abolish instant replay. A mob of callers chime in on the game and if Rob is correct that replay needs to go. They wrap the hour with a conversation about the chances this year for Lamar Jackson, Joe Burrow, and Justin Herbert. 

#oddcouple

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 2 - Rob Parker & Kerry Rhodes - Lane Kiffin is a HERO + George Wrighster
item.description:
Rob Parker & Kerry Rhodes are in for Dan and the Danette's on a Labor Day edition of The Dan Patrick Show. Rob declares Lane Kiffin as a hero in the college football space. On3 College Football analyst George Wrighster joins the show to discuss everything college football including LSU's big win, Lane Kiffin's impact on the sport, and George's Oregon Ducks. They wrap the hour with Kerry's breakdown of his alma mater Louisville's heartbreaking Week 1 loss to Ole Miss. 

#oddcouple

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 3 - Rob Parker & Kerry Rhodes - NFL Opening Week + Adam Caplan
item.description:
Rob Parker & Kerry Rhodes are in for Dan and the Danette's on a Labor Day edition of The Dan Patrick Show. The guys talk everything NFL opening week including both of their disagreements with the Rams as Super Bowl favorites. Folks call in and give their Super Bowl picks, and Fox Sports Radio NFL Insider Adam Caplan joins the show to give his thoughts on the latest from the NFL news cycle and Week 1 matchups! The hour wraps with NFL Week 1 predictions. 

#oddcouple

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 3 – Chris Fowler, Callers
item.description:
Chris Fowler drops by to talk a little tennis as the US Open is heating up, and he weighs in on Week 1 of the college football season. Plus, Dan takes calls about all the craziness that went on over this holiday weekend.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 2 – More Michigan Mishigas, Gerald McCoy
item.description:
Dan continues to explore the fallout from Michigan’s controversial win over Western Michigan. And former NFL DE Gerald McCoy stops by to help preview Week 1 of the NFL season which begins tomorrow.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 1 – Michigan Escapes, Lane Kiffin Embracing Villainhood
item.description:
Dan dives deep into the controversial ending to the Michigan/Western Michigan game over the weekend and you might be surprised to hear what he was most annoyed by. And he thinks Lane Kiffin is on the right track as he seems to be embracing his role as the heel of the SEC.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 3 – MAC and Western Michigan Want Their Win Back, Dr. Meeta Singh
item.description:
The MAC and Western Michigan have petitioned the NCAA to overturn the result of their loss to Michigan and award them their win and DP thinks they have a valid case. Plus, sleep expert Dr. Meeta Singh joins the show to talk about the sleep issues experienced by many professional athletes on the eve of the Rams and 49ers playing in Australia.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 2 – College Football Playoff Expansion, Booger McFarland
item.description:
Dan and the Danettes discuss the push to expand the College Football Playoff to 24 teams and how it will affect the regular season. Plus, former NFL and LSU DT Booger McFarland drops by to talk some pigskin.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 1 – NFL Opening Night, Pat Forde
item.description:
Dan is excited for tonight’s opening game in the NFL and isn’t surprised Aaron Donald won’t be playing in Australia tomorrow for the Rams. And college football insider Pat Forde drops by to talk Michigan/Western Michigan, SEC vs. LSU, and the idea of expanding the College Football Playoff to 24 teams.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 3 – Multi-Sport Madness, U2 Controversy
item.description:
Dan and the Danettes talk about the aura surrounding Bo Jackson in his heyday and how Deion Sanders aspired to those same heights as a multi-sport athlete. Dan and Dylan clash hard over U2 and whether this is actually an all-time great band or whether they are just annoying.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 2 – Netflix Negligence, Albert Breer
item.description:
Netflix blows off the Dan Patrick Show and doesn’t make anyone from Thursday’s NFL broadcast available. But does the rest of the country know the game is on Netflix tonight? MMQB’s Albert Breer joins Dan to talk about the continued international expansion of the NFL, including potentially moving into the Middle East or even holding a Super Bowl outside the United States; plus, Albert dishes on the timeline for Aaron Donald and what all happened with Drake Maye last night.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 1 – Drake Maye Disappointment, Joe Thomas
item.description:
The NFL returned with a roar on Wednesday night with a Super Bowl rematch. The Seahawks claimed victory again, but Dan has his microscope on Patriots’ quarterback Drake Maye as he throws three interceptions in the 4th quarter. Pro Football Hall of Famer Joe Thomas talks about how the Seahawks adjusted when quarterback Sam Darnold left the game, and how the Rams and 49ers will be impacted by different travel schedules to Australia.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 3 – 25 Years Later, Steve Young
item.description:
Dan reflects on the 25th anniversary of the September 11th tragedy. Hall of Fame quarterback and football analyst Steve Young joins Dan to talk about the travel logistics handled by the Rams and 49ers to play in Australia, who’s facing the biggest questions in this NFL season, what kind of fights he would get into; Steve and Dan spar over his golf game at Tahoe too.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 2 – Charles Davis, College Football Week 2
item.description:
College football analyst Charles Davis joins Dan to discuss storylines going into Week 2 of the college season, including how close Boise St. got to beating Oregon, the continued drama over Michigan and the pressure on Texas and Ohio State as they meet this weekend. The Danettes weigh in on the most interesting and least interesting NFL games, and the Most Must Win games of the college slate.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 1 – Travel Woes, Guardian Caps, Taxes
item.description:
While the world is blaming the Rams travel arrangements for their dismal showing last night from Australia, Dan thinks the answer is much simpler. Fritzy has to wear a guardian cap. Dan and callers discuss the weird situation around the idea that Rams quarterback Matthew Stafford has to pay million in taxes to play Week 1 – or does he?

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Not So Fast Episode 9
item.description:
On today's show, Pabst & Perloff break down the 49ers dominant win over the Rams in Australia, preview the weekend in college football with NBC's Connor Rogers, preview some of the biggest games on Sunday in Week 1 of the NFL, give their latest Warm Takes and more!
